summary: The registrant, Cresud S.A.C.I.F. y A., filed a Form 6-K attaching an English translation of a letter to Argentine regulators under Buenos Aires Stock Exchange Section 63. The filing reports annual financial results for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026, including net income, comprehensive income, equity details, share capital, and shareholder composition. It notes a restatement due to an error in inflation adjustment of share premium from warrant exercises, and discloses that Eduardo Sergio Elsztain is the principal shareholder with 39.12% ownership. No transaction, special situation, or corporate event is announced—it is a routine periodic report.
